OddsEntry.title: Odds Entry
OddsEntry.description: A single point-in-time snapshot of racing odds parsed from an image.

raceId.description: Unique identifier for the race (e.g., Track-RaceNumber-Date)

rawData.description: The raw JSON/Matrix parsed from the image

shiftScore.description: The difference between this entry and the previous one

userId.description: The user who uploaded the data

/races/{raceId}/entries/{entryId}.description: History of odds entries for a specific race

/users/{userId}/recentRaces.description: User specific metadata for quick access
